summary: The single medium finding is confirmed, with the scope made precise. The accepted GEF link map records its three QuiverRepresentations prerequisites (Quiver 2 → GEF 4, Quiver 3 → GEF 4, Quiver 4 → GEF 5) only in existingLinks, and existingLinks is not merged into the atlas. The only links entries for these pairs are in the Quiver link map, which is status 'partial', has no review, and has no data/links counterpart. Its link job (#63) is back to state:available and its review (#130) is blocked. The production assembler gives 2,840 stages and 8,007 edges. Neither the three edges nor any forward or reverse path between their endpoints is present, while the six SPC/Zigzag hosted pairs are present. Merging exactly the red team's three proposed links gives 8,010 edges, and a second merge also gives 8,010. The merged graph and the union of the atlas, every research link map and the proposals (8,118 edges) are both acyclic. All six quotations are literal substrings of the current stage descriptions. The mathematics checks out, including the Cartan transpose, with C_Gᵀ·E = I verified on the quiver 1→2. The library does not already supply the imports at the pin: TauCeti has cartanMap and the combinatorial eulerForm/titsPolarForm, but no Krull–Schmidt uniqueness and no Hom − Ext¹ identity. Scope corrections: (1) the Quiver 4 → GEF 5 edge covers only the ungraded identity; (2) the three existingLinks entries are retagged, not left claiming coverage; (3) the stale 'construct the categorical Cartan map' wording in the Quiver packet's reason is not copied.

findings.reason: Confirmed, with the scope made precise. Evidence checked at main aee3144d. (a) The accepted GEF map (review.status accepted, reviewer codex-hjdg0j) carries the three Quiver pairs only as existingLinks[0..2], state 'present-at-review', recordedIn the QuiverRepresentations research packet. Its 15 links are all outgoing from GEF. The promoted data/links copy is byte-identical. (b) The Quiver link map has status 'partial' and no review block, and data/links has no Quiver file. Link job #63 is state:available (its claim lapsed on 2026-09-21), and review #130 is state:blocked, so the gap will not close by itself soon. (c) Code path: build.assemble loads only data/links (build.py L69–75). merge_links rejects packets without an accepted review and iterates packet['links'] only (decompositions.py L267ff), so existingLinks never reaches the graph. (d) I ran the production assembler in memory, writing nothing, and reproduced 2,840 stages and 8,007 distinct stage edges. All six endpoints are atlas stages. None of the three Quiver→GEF pairs is an edge, and with requires included there is no forward or reverse path between any of them. The six SPC/Zigzag hosted pairs are direct edges. (e) Mathematics. Quiver 2 → GEF 4: K₀(proj A) is the group completion of the monoid of isomorphism classes of finitely generated projectives. Krull–Schmidt existence and uniqueness make that monoid free on the indecomposable projectives, which gives the basis GEF 4 asks for 'under the … Krull--Schmidt hypotheses supplied by the quiver roadmap'. The simple basis of G₀ is Jordan–Hölder, as the reason says. Quiver 3 → GEF 4: Quiver has C_Q(i,j) = [P_i:S_j] and GEF has entry (i,j) = [P_j:S_i], so C_G = C_Qᵀ. The correction dim_k Hom_A(P_i,M) = dim_k End(S_i)·[M:S_i] is right over a non-splitting field. Check on the quiver 1→2: P_1 has dimension vector (1,1) and P_2 has (0,1), so C_G = [[1,0],[1,1]] and E = [[1,−1],[0,1]], giving C_Gᵀ·E = I, i.e. χ(P_i,S_j) = δ_ij. Quiver 4 → GEF 5: kQ is hereditary for acyclic Q, so Ext^{≥2} = 0 and the categorical Ext-Euler value of finite-dimensional M, N is dim Hom − dim Ext¹. Ringel's identity then gives the comparison, once categorical Ext¹ is identified with the resolution cokernel, which remains GEF work. (f) The imports are not already in the pinned library, so the edges are substantive. TauCeti f790474 has cartanMap (CartanMap.lean L235) and the combinatorial eulerForm/titsForm/titsPolarForm (Quiver/EulerForm.lean). It has no Krull–Schmidt uniqueness and no Hom − Ext¹ identity. (g) Quotations and checks. All six proposed quotations are literal substrings of the current atlas stage descriptions. A scratch copy of the GEF map with the three proposed links (18 links) passes check_links.py with 0 errors and 0 warnings. merge_links of the three links into the assembled atlas gives 8,010 edges, a second merge also gives 8,010, and its cycle check passes. The union of the assembled edges, every research link map's links, all requires entries and the proposals (8,118 edges) is acyclic. Adversarial notes on the red team: its Quiver 3 reason rightly corrects the Quiver packet's stale wording 'construct the categorical Cartan map'. cartanMap is baseline, so the import identifies the matrix of the existing map and does not construct one. GEF 5 says 'Tau Ceti's Ringel form', which could be read as TauCeti.eulerForm alone. But the comparison needs the homological identity and the length-one resolution, which only Quiver 4 plans, so re-deriving them in GEF would duplicate Quiver 4 (§15). The red team's proposed reason omits the graded case. GEF 5 also asks for a path-length-graded comparison, and Quiver 4 is ungraded, so the edge must not be read as supplying it. Severity medium stands: three real prerequisites of planned GEF theorems are missing from the atlas, and nothing GEF builds changes. Authorized scope for FIX-RT: (i) Append exactly the three proposedLinks of the result file to the links array of research/blueprint/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_GrothendieckEulerForms.json, with their sources, targets, confidence 'inferred' and evidence verbatim. Use the red team's reasons, not the Quiver packet's. Add to the Quiver 4 → GEF 5 reason: 'Ungraded only; the path-length-graded bigraded comparison and its q = 1 specialization remain GEF Layers 5–6 work.' (ii) In existingLinks[0..2], replace state 'present-at-review' with a value saying that the host is an unreviewed, partial research packet and that the pair is now carried in this packet's links. Alternatively, delete the three entries and record them in a provenance note. The other six existingLinks entries stay unchanged. (iii) Correct the summary, reviewFollowUp and review narrative that call all nine partner pairs covered: six are promoted through SPC/Zigzag, and three were research-only and are now GEF links. (iv) The changed packet then needs renewed independent acceptance and normal promotion to data/links. Editing research text alone does not change the graph. Out of scope: the 15 existing links, overlaps, requests, roadmap READMEs, the Quiver packet, and any graded Quiver→GEF edge. Do not promote the Quiver packet or add edges to the generated graph by hand. If a reviewed Quiver packet is promoted first, the fix is still harmless, because merge_links deduplicates ordered pairs.
